service-call.name: ironstone.projects.WorkItemServices.quickAdd#WorkItem

actions.script: const groupBy = groupField || 'statusId' const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.projects.WorkItemServices.move#WorkItemCard').parameters({workEffortId: workEffortId, groupField: groupBy, value: ec.web.parameters[groupBy] ?? ''}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: out.message}]})

ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.TaskServices.get#TaskAccess').parameters({workEffortId: workEffortId, need: 'update', app: 'projects'}).call() if (!ec.message.hasError()) ec.service.sync().name('mantle.work.TaskServices.move#Task').parameters({workEffortId: workEffortId, parentWorkEffortId: parentWorkEffortId || null, previousSiblingId: previousSiblingId || null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: ec.resource.expand(parentWorkEffortId ? '${id} moved under ${parent}' : '${id} moved to the top level', '', {id: workEffortId, parent: parentWorkEffortId})}]})

render-mode.text: ${JSON.stringify({t: "link", id: "WorkItemsNew", text: ec.l10n.localize("New work item"), url: sri.buildUrl("//Projects/QuickCreate").path + "?kind=workItem" + (rootWorkEffortId ? "&rootWorkEffortId=" + encodeURIComponent(rootWorkEffortId) : "")})}

label.text: ${hoursTotals.estimatedText || '0'} h estimated · ${hoursTotals.remainingText || '0'} h remaining · ${hoursTotals.actualText || '0'} h actual
